subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Sphinx and Riddles
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Sphinx and Riddles.

hook.text: The Greek Sphinx asked travelers a riddle: answer correctly or die. Oedipus solved it and the Sphinx destroyed itself.

buildup.text: The riddle: what walks on four legs, two legs, then three? Answer: a human—crawling, walking, then leaning on a cane.

discovery.text: Egypt's Sphinx has a lion's body and a pharaoh's head—guarding, not questioning. Two cultures, two sphinxes.

twist.text: The Greek Sphinx says knowledge is power—answer or die. The Egyptian Sphinx says power is silent—no riddle, just awe.

climax.text: Both sphinxes guard thresholds. One uses intellect, the other authority. The hybrid beast tests who may pass.

punchline.text: Solve the riddle. Or face the silence.

quiz.question: Who solved the Greek Sphinx's riddle?
